articles.title: Prysmian secures framework agreement in Greece for island connections
articles.summary: Prysmian has been awarded a framework agreement by Greek transmission operator IPTO covering submarine cable supply for island interconnections. The agreement spans multiple links in the Aegean and includes engineering, procurement and installation scope.
articles.reason: Confirmed framework agreement awarded to a direct competitor in a market where NKT also bids.
articles.nkt_implication: Removes near-term tender opportunities in the Greek island programme and strengthens Prysmian's position with IPTO as a repeat customer.

articles.title: German Ambassador Visits the Power Cable Factory at Osaka Works
articles.categories: Customer news, New Factory / Factory Expansions
articles.summary: The German Ambassador to Japan visited Sumitomo Electric's power cable factory at Osaka Works. The visit focused on high-voltage submarine cable manufacturing capacity and the company's involvement in European offshore grid projects.
articles.reason: Signals Sumitomo positioning for European offshore work, though no contract or capacity change is announced.
articles.nkt_implication: Possible early indicator of Sumitomo increasing focus on the European market where NKT holds established positions.
